def: Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian

occurrences.text: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
